messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Elevated 5xx+gateway timeouts on inference-gateway-prod detected at 2026-05-12T15:12:01Z. Alerting on 5xx_rate > 2% and p95 latency > 1200ms. Link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/INC-3245

Devon (oncall): acked, paging. I'm on it. Starting triage — checking gateway and scheduler. Any customer reports?

Emily (cs): We're getting 1 inbound ticket from Acme -> timeouts, 2 others reporting "generation failed". Escalating to ENG. Customers impacted: Acme corp (prod), Streamly (some requests), and internal demos.

Maya R: looking at gateway logs — seeing a sharp spike in request queue depth and batch formation latency. Gateway 5xx are mostly 502/504 from batcher gateway timeout.

Liam C: grabbing prometheus graphs. p95 scheduling latency jumped from 80ms -> 1900ms. batch_queue_length peaked at ~840. batch_process_time spiked to >500ms per batch. Snapshots: `curl -s http://prom/prom/api/v1/query?query=batch_queue_length` gave output...

Maya R: also seeing head-of-line blocking on scheduler: a few long-running batches with sequence_length ~4096 that prevent small requests from being scheduled. KV-cache insert times high.

Devon (oncall): mitigation idea: temporarily reduce max_batch_wait_ms and enable preemptive_eviction for pending small requests. Can someone push a config change to gateway-control-plane? If yes, do it in canary then roll.

Liam C: I'll prepare the change. Proposed diff:
```
PATCH /v1/configs/gateway
{
  "batch": { "max_wait_ms": 20, "enable_preemptive_eviction": true }
}
```
Applying to canary node set 'gateway-canary-3' now.

ops-bot: deploy started -> gateway-config-update to gateway-canary-3 by Liam C.

Maya R: meanwhile I can enable backup-route to serve small inference requests on a lightweight fast-path model (mistral-lite) to relieve scheduler pressure.

Liam C: canary applied. Rolling to next 10% of traffic if metrics stay good. Watching errors.

(5m later)

ops-bot: canary metrics: 5xx_rate down from 3.8% -> 1.2% on canary nodes; p95 latency down 1900ms -> 240ms. No regressions seen. Proceed with gradual rollout.

Devon (oncall): good. Start 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 6 minutes. I'll coordinate with Maya for backup route.

Maya R: backup-route enabled for path `/v1/generate?fast=true` -> routed to mistral-lite cluster. Using prefix caching for small prompts.

Sara N: customer update: posting to status.redwood: short mitigation in progress, limited customer impact, teams investigating. I'll post an update in 15m.

(rollout)

Liam C: full rollout complete. cluster-wide max_wait_ms=20, preemptive_eviction=true.

Maya R: queue length dropping, current batch_queue_length ~65, batch_process_time ~90ms. Head-of-line eviction triggered about 1200 times (small requests preempted long batches) — acceptable for now.

Devon (oncall): monitoring for regressions. Any downstream side-effects? model accuracy, truncated responses?

Maya R: no accuracy regressions; some long-context requests saw truncated completion due to preemption — logged ~0.3% truncation. We'll track with quality alerts.

Emily (cs): Acme confirmed decrease in errors, reports look good. They'll wait for full incident summary.

Sara N: I posted status update: https://status.redwood/incident/INC-3245. Included mitigation steps and impacted customers list.

Devon (oncall): ok preparation for handoff. I'll run a short blameless checklist: cause hypothesis, mitigation, next steps. Hypothesis: long-running large-sequence inferences filled batches and blocked scheduler; batching window too large for mixed workloads.

Maya R: logs showing offending requests: client_id=internal-test, seq_len=4096, 3 concurrent heavy calls maintained for ~6m. Need to add fairness by request size.

Liam C: opened a followup ticket INF-512 with actions: enforce size-based scheduling, adaptive batch window per route, strengthen preemption throttles, improve alerts (queue depth >2000). ETA for changes is 3 days.

Devon (oncall): handoff to Liam for overnight monitoring at 17:30 UTC. I'll create the oncall note. Liam, you have paging rights.

Liam C: taking over. I'll keep the runbook open and monitor for 12h. If the 5xx rate climbs above 1.5% re-alert ops.

Devon (oncall): thumbs up. Postmortem required; set sev->P1, but impact limited due to quick mitigation. Add customer follow-ups.

Maya R: quick commands used during triage:
```
# reduce batch window
http PATCH https://controlplane/api/v1/configs/gateway batch.max_wait_ms=20
# enable preemptive eviction
http PATCH https://controlplane/api/v1/configs/gateway batch.enable_preemptive_eviction=true
# enable backup route
http POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routes/reload {"route":"/v1/generate?fast=true","dest":"mistral-lite"}
```

Emily (cs): I'll collect impacted customer contacts and help coordinate postmortem comms.

Sara N: add to postmortem: root cause hypothesis, timeline, customer impact, mitigations, long-term fixes, and monitoring improvements. Assign owners for each action.

Devon (oncall): thanks team. Closing incident in Slack once postmortem doc is ready. :white_check_mark:

Liam C: monitoring heartbeat ok. Reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - 5xx rate returned to baseline. Incident closed by Devon at 2026-05-12T18:45:23Z.

Devon (oncall): filing a short ops note and linking INF-512 and INC-3245. Good job everyone — fast response and clear handoff.
